content.text: Edeliǥen ku sikew, Nengazen,
su midlibri a kenikew te kezeetan
ne wazè nu ituǥut he mekezayandayan is menge kuntada ku tenged te kebpekesavuk ku.
Nengazen he Megbevayè ku,
mibpetavang a kenikew tenged te zaru ku,
ne mibewian a kenikew.
Midlibri a kenikew te kemetayen.
Wazà nu ituǥut he mepatey a.
Sikiyu is metinumanen he menge etew te Nengazen,
deliǥa niw is Nengazen pinaaǥi te kegkanta niw.
Deliǥa niw sikandin te kedalig pinaaǥi te kedtentenuzi niw te kegkewaǥas din.
Su melemu egkaawà is pauk din,
iyan, is keupiya zin mulà, ebpedayun te wazà pidtemanan.
Egkeseeng ki emun timpu te mezukilem,
piru egkelipey ki zed emun ebmeselem en.
Nengazen, tenged te keupiya nu in-iring a kenikew te vuntud su midlig-enan a kenikew.
Ne tenged te melig-en is kebpekesavuk ku,
ne ziyà te ǥehinawa ku ebpekekaǥi a te, “Kenà ad iyan egkemenu.”
Piru hein wazà a kenikew seǥipaa, neǥezam ku is kegkahandek.
Nengumew-umew a kenikew, Nengazen, ne midhangyù a.
Ke siak te,
“Hengkey is egkekuwa nu emun ebpatey a?
Su kenè en man ebpekezalig kenikew is minatey en.
Ne kenè din en daan igkeseysey is kebmetinumanen nu.
Pemineǥa a kenikew, Nengazen, ne kehizuwi a.
Ne tevangi a.”
Tenged te tavang nu, mid-ilisan nu te melipayen he kedsayew is keseengan ku.
Impeluwas nu kedì is bisti ku he saku he tuus te kedlalew ku,
ne mibeǥayan a kenikew te kelipey.
Umbe, kenà a ebpereremek dà, kekenà, egkanta a te menge kedalig kenikew.
Nengazen he Megbevayè ku, ebpeselamatan ku sikew te wazà pidtemanan.
